actors.name: Donald Trump
actors.blurb: President Donald Trump continues to define the national and international news cycle through wide-ranging executive actions, controversial infrastructure plans, and aggressive foreign policy moves. His administration is driving headlines with proposed arms sales to Israel and Saudi Arabia, rollback of environmental protections, diplomatic engagements with China, and campaign rallies in battleground states.

actors.role: Vice President of the United States

His public statements and podcast appeals for political support ahead of upcoming midterms have drawn both headlines and sharp criticism from opponents.
